rule: footerText() in ../attribution.mjs shows one line per on-screen source whose id appears under a loaded layer, de-duplicated by source id and by rendered text, in the order of "sources" below, each followed by its licence short name unless the line already names the licence. aboutList() gives the longer list for the Controls/About panel. Sources with on_screen=false are credited in ATTRIBUTION.md only. {year} is replaced by the source year, else the caller year, else the current year.

layer_notes.terrain: Past a staged site's 1 m tiles, a far ring to about 4 km at 8 m and 16 m spacing, decimated from the EA LIDAR Composite DTM (the mean of the 1 m nodes round each node), OGL v3.0.
layer_notes.slope: Slope derived from EA LIDAR Composite DTM 1m (Horn 1981).
layer_notes.flow: Flow derived from EA LIDAR Composite DTM 1m.
layer_notes.ways: Roads from OS Open Roads; rail from OS OpenMap - Local (both OGL).
layer_notes.terrain-fallback: Copernicus GLO-30 is a 30 m surface model, not bare earth.
layer_notes.land: ALC grade boundaries; the provisional map is about 1:250,000 and does not split grade 3. CROME crops are not drawn yet (on_screen false until they are).
layer_notes.buffers: Zones drawn round the grid lines (OSM), watercourses (OS Open Rivers), roads (OS Open Roads) and hedges (EA LIDAR DSMs); distances cited in web/world/buffers.mjs.
layer_notes.ground: Desktop study only, not a substitute for ground investigation. Not imported (licensed or no open vector service): BGS Geology 50k, coal mine entries, coal mining reporting area, aquifer designations, GeoSure, radon, Soilscapes.
layer_notes.terrain-live: Away from staged sites, EA LIDAR Composite DTM 1m is fetched live from the Environment Agency WCS.
layer_notes.construction: Construction study (GPU, illustrative): tower positions inferred from OpenStreetMap (ODbL, its own file and credit line); levels from EA LIDAR Composite DTM 1m; sizes, heights and sag assumed.
